q: What do I need to have ready?
a: A clear problem and someone who can answer questions within a day or two. Brand assets and sample data help, but I can work without them at first.

q: How do we work across time zones?
a: I'm on Venezuela time (UTC−4), which overlaps with US mornings and European afternoons. We meet once a week; the rest happens in writing, and you always see progress on a live link.

q: Can you take over an existing project?
a: Yes. I start with a paid one-week audit of the code and data, then propose whether to fix, extend or rebuild.

q: Why build on Google Workspace instead of a custom app?
a: When your team already lives in Sheets and Gmail, an Apps Script tool ships in days, costs nothing to host and stays readable for audits. When you outgrow it, I'll tell you and plan the move.
